title: ze_FFXIV_Reisen_Temple
description:
FFXIV-Reisen Temple
最终幻想14：醴泉神社

Map by @Seth

This is a Zombie Escape map,Base on Reisen Temple sence from game Final Fantasy 14.

>It's not final version!
Map only current contain 2 Stage yet.(Total 5 Stage.)
Human + Zombie item,Total 14 Item.(Item slow buff only works in server.)
2 Bosses,Genbu/Byakko/.(Seiryu in Stage 3.)
Simple Laser at Stage 2.

3 new item will add in Stage 3 update.

<"Addoutput" KeyValue are used in map for item targetname and slow buff.
It won't work in singleplayer.>

Even the map is kinda small,But i still hope you enjoy the map. xd
Rate the map if u like it,thanks you!

Thanks to tenshi for helping.

------------------------------------------------>
该地图原型源自最终幻想14中的醴泉神社,由我对场景用特效光影等进行进一步的美化.

>目前版本仅全图的部分流程前瞻,非最终版本.

本图暂时有2关,总共5关会在后续更新.
人类和僵尸总共14种不同的神器随机刷新.(后续会添加最后3种神器.)
暂时2个Boss,四圣兽中的玄武,白虎.(贝利亚斯,青龙,朱雀,芝诺斯)
第二关暂时解馋用的高中低跳刀.(高难跳刀于后续关卡)

<Addoutput键值已给神器的减速和Targetname使用,因此单机无法展现神器完全效果.>
<仅能在有对应插件的服务器正常使用.>

萌新第一次做FF图,可能有不少潜在Bug,多多体量捏.

感谢天子提供的帮助.
